name: Reads & Spot-Up Shooting
summary: Warm up your handle with your eyes up, shoot off self-pass catches, read a partner's closeout, then finish with tough dribble shuttles.

drills.name: Eyes-Up Wall Spots
drills.equipment: 1 ball, a wall or garage door
drills.summary: Control the ball low and fast while your eyes stay locked on a target.
steps: Pick a spot on a wall about head height, 10 feet away.
Dribble hard at your knee with your right hand for 30 seconds. Eyes stay on the spot.
Switch to your left hand for 30 seconds.
Do crossovers, then between-the-legs, 30 seconds each.
Finish with 30 seconds of any combo you want. Never look down.

drills.name: Self-Toss Spin Catches
drills.summary: Spin the ball out to yourself and catch it ready to shoot, like a real kick-out pass.
steps: Start in the paint facing a spot about 15 feet out.
Spin the ball out so it bounces once at your spot.
Run to it and catch on a hop with your feet set and knees bent.
Shoot right away. Rebound and go to the next spot.
Work five spots around the arc: corner, wing, top, wing, corner. Repeat.

drills.name: Closeout Read & Go
drills.summary: Read how your partner closes out and make the right play fast.
steps: Stand on the wing with the ball. Partner starts under the rim.
Partner runs at you and shows one look: hand high, short closeout, or flying at you.
Hand high or flying at you: shot fake and drive to the rim.
Short closeout with space: shoot it.
Decide in one second. Switch roles halfway through.

drills.name: Arc Spoke Shuttles
drills.summary: Dribble hard from the rim to five arc spots and back to build legs and handle under fatigue.
steps: Start under the rim with the ball.
Speed dribble to the right corner arc, touch the line, dribble back to the rim.
Repeat to the right wing, top, left wing and left corner.
Rest 20 seconds after each full round of five spots.
Go again until time runs out. Use your outside hand going out.
